title: Public utilities - Corporation Commission jurisdiction and rate regulation
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 17, secs. 151 et seq.
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search (Title 17, SearchText 'public utility'): 52 current sections, the lowest-numbered cluster being 17-151, 17-151.1, 17-154, 17-155, 17-160.1, 17-180.1, 17-180.2, 17-184, 17-185 and the 17-191 series. 'Title 17 - Corporation Commission' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'.
notes: WEAKEST ENTRY FOR OKLAHOMA - a human should confirm the division. Title 17 has no named consolidating utilities Act, so this is a code division cited by its opening section rather than a short title, and the boundary of the division was inferred from the section numbers the register's search returned, not read from a table of contents. Most operative billing, deposit and disconnection rules are Corporation Commission administrative rules (Okla. Admin. Code title 165) rather than statute.
